displayPattern: Display on a Wi-Fi-connected Samsung washer: dn
meaning: Downloading: Samsung says dn means the washer is downloading an update. It is not a fault. The controls, including the dial, do not respond until the update finishes.
causes: The washer is downloading a software update
The controls are locked out on purpose while the update runs
diySteps: Leave the washer powered on. Do not unplug it or switch off its breaker while dn is showing
Wait. Samsung says updates take about 15 minutes, and the message disappears when the update is complete
Do not keep turning the dial or pressing buttons. Samsung says the controls will not respond during the update
If dn stays on, check that your home Wi-Fi is working, because Samsung's time limit assumes there are no Wi-Fi connection issues
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: Samsung says to request service only if dn has been displayed for more than 30 minutes while the washer stayed powered on the whole time and there were no Wi-Fi connection issues. Under 30 minutes, keep waiting. This is not the dE door error, the ddC Add Door error or the 9C1 / PF voltage error.
